message.content: I found the bug. In `xmlParsePubidLiteral` (parser.c:4449), `tmp = xmlRealloc(buf, size)` uses the OLD `size` instead of `newSize`, so the buffer is never actually grown while `size` is updated to the larger value. This causes out-of-bounds writes. Let me verify the call path and build setup.
